blurb: Guests can purchase wines online or join one of four wine clubs offering shipments of 6 to 12 bottles with various benefits including tastings and exclusive events. The winery farms five estate vineyards organically in the Dundee Hills and uses traditional, natural winemaking techniques emphasizing slow, native fermentations and extended barrel aging. The winery is family-run with a focus on sustainability and terroir expression.
